title: Harmonized adapter status enum + per-adapter mapping template
description: Frozen 8-value status enum shared by every adapter (leafblower + every competitor, R and Python arms). See contract.md §2.3/§2.4 for how this relates to the `converged` boolean (algorithmic: converged == (status=='converged') after the bound-violation upgrade; NOT a margin_linf<=tol fit gate).

StatusValueSemantics.converged: Solver reported a clean, in-tolerance exit (leafblower RK_OK; competitor package's own success path).
StatusValueSemantics.no_conv: Solver ran to its iteration/step budget without meeting its own stopping test and did not classify the outcome as budget-exhausted-but-improving, infeasible, or a stall (leafblower RK_ERR_NOCONV).
StatusValueSemantics.infeasible: Solver detected the problem has no feasible solution under the given bounds/margins (leafblower RK_ERR_INFEAS: empty cell with positive target, or total-capacity/structural-zero violation) and halted with a guarded refusal rather than returning silently out-of-bound weights.
StatusValueSemantics.bound_violation: HARNESS-recomputed only (no leafblower RK_ERR_* maps here directly — leafblower halts with `infeasible`/`bad_arg` instead of silently violating bounds). Set when the harness inspects a bounded problem's returned weights_ref and finds at least one weight outside [L_c, U_c]; used for competitor adapters wrapping packages with no native bound-violation detection, so a silent violation is never reported as `converged`.
StatusValueSemantics.bad_arg: Invalid argument / malformed problem input rejected before any solve iterate was produced (leafblower RK_ERR_BADARG: e.g. n_cats_total too large, L_c > U_c, un-normalized targets). No usable weights exist; see contract.md §2.1 for the all-NaN sentinel weights_ref convention.
StatusValueSemantics.budget: Iteration/step budget exhausted while the loss was still decreasing (leafblower RK_ERR_BUDGET) — distinct from `no_conv`: the solver was making progress but ran out of budget, so raising max_iterations is the indicated remedy.
StatusValueSemantics.stall: Loss function plateaued at what the solver believes is a constrained optimum (leafblower RK_ERR_STALL). Per src/types.hpp: weights ARE considered valid best-effort output at stall, unlike bad_arg/infeasible.
StatusValueSemantics.error: Uncaught adapter/package-level exception (R condition caught via tryCatch, Python exception) that does not correspond to any of the above solver-native outcomes — e.g. a package crash, a type error in the adapter's translation layer, or an unexpected native-library abort. error_message MUST be populated.

AdapterStatusMapping.description: Template every adapter WU (R competitors, Python competitors, leafblower R/Python) fills in: raw solver-native codes/exception classes -> the harmonized StatusEnum value. Keys are adapter-specific (integer exit codes as strings, or exception class names); values MUST be one of StatusEnum.

leafblower_mapping_worked_example._comment: Filled per contract.md §5 / DESIGN.md §8: leafblower's C API RK_ERR_* codes (leafblower.h) mapped into the harmonized enum. Non-normative example payload conforming to #/$defs/AdapterStatusMapping — every downstream competitor adapter WU produces its own analogous mapping object.

adapter_mapping_template._comment: Copy this stub per adapter WU and replace with the wrapped package's actual native codes/exception class names -> StatusEnum. Every key in a completed mapping must resolve to one of the 8 StatusEnum values; no adapter may invent a 9th status.
